WHO WE ARE

Learning today.
Leading tomorrow.

Delhi Public School Narkatiaganj has been part of the local learning community since 2011. We aim to provide students with a supportive atmosphere that values knowledge, discipline, creativity and good character.

ACADEMICS

Strong foundations for every learner.

Our school learning journey spans Play Group to Class 10. Teaching plans, subjects and assessments are designed to support age-appropriate learning and steady progress.

Play Group & Primary

Early learning through curiosity, exploration and guided activities.

Middle School

Build understanding, confidence and independent learning habits.

Secondary

Strengthen subject knowledge, discipline and exam readiness.
